description: This file defines a JSON-RPC interface schema for the LISA API, including method definitions, error codes, data structures, and event notifications related to application management and resource handling.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Download the application bundle and initiate installation process.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Delete persistent data stored locally for an application.

methods.name: getStorageDetails
methods.description: Get storage usage details for an application.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieve the list of installed applications.

methods.name: setAuxMetadata
methods.description: Set arbitrary metadata for an application.

methods.name: clearAuxMetadata
methods.description: Clear specific metadata key for an application.

methods.name: getProgress
methods.description: Get estimated progress of an asynchronous operation.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Lock an application to prevent modifications.

methods.name: getLockInfo
methods.description: Retrieve lock information for an application.
